title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Tiffin Tracker v5.8.6 is now available!
releaseNotes: Universal UPI Payment Fix: Fixed 'Could not fetch profile or amount' errors across PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, and Cred
Strict NPCI Formatting: Unencoded VPA '@' symbol, two-decimal positive amounts, and clean alphanumeric transaction notes
Direct App Quick Launchers: Added 1-tap dedicated payment buttons for Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm alongside the system chooser
Android Package Visibility: Added native UPI queries declaration in manifest for seamless multi-app intent resolution
Fixed New User Retention: Prevented race conditions and membership drops when roommates join room from multiple phones
Restored Ledger Persistence & Matrix Sync: Month-scoped Firestore storage with automatic meal slot initialization across all days
Restored CSV Spreadsheet Export: Download full Excel/Google Sheets compatible monthly summaries directly from exports and settings
Flexible Meal Logging: Fixed rigid lockouts; roommates can freely log and update meals with a smooth 3-day grace period
Same-Day Meal Locking: Roommates can only modify their meal portions on the current day; past locked dates require Admin Password/PIN to unlock
Native Repository Linking: Replaced all legacy web app and release URLs with direct GitHub repository links across invite cards and modals
Streamlined Interface: Removed deprecated CSV/Spreadsheet export controls for a clutter-free, distraction-free workflow
Updated Documentation: Overhauled repository README with Sovereign Dabba branding, architecture guide, and full screenshot gallery
Comprehensive Flicker Fix: Zero flickering across Daily Logger, Master Sheet, Split, and Amul Tracker using deterministic signature caching and atomic DOM updates
Clean Interface: Removed test push button and redundant background sync polling intervals
Strict Admin Security: Regular members joining from new devices strictly adopt member profile and cannot adopt admin status without verified PIN
Real-time Room Deletion Reset: Connected phones immediately auto-reset to gate screen if flat is removed or purged
Zero-Flicker Master Sheet: Eliminated table flickering and DOM thrashing with signature caching, atomic updates, and single-delegate event handling
Strict Admin Privilege Guard: Required verified Admin Security PIN before granting admin access; new devices and joining members join strictly as members
Permanent Kick Enforcement: Neutralized resurrection loops by eliminating recursive snapshot writes and enforcing kickedMembers blacklist across all sync layers
Rock-Solid Real-Time Sync: Single authoritative Firestore source of truth with debounced 60fps renderAll pipeline
Brand Identity Overhaul: Modern, high-precision minimalist app logo featuring the iconic 3-tiered Sovereign 'T' Dabba
Universal Asset Refresh: High-DPI Android adaptive launcher icons (mdpi to xxxhdpi), native splash screens, and vector branding
Luxury Startup Experience: Sleek in-app splash reveal with the new obsidian-emerald vector monogram
Scrollable Update Modal: Compact collapsible patch details optimized for smaller phone displays
Instant Direct Join: Completely removed entry request feature; new flatmates enter instantly with the 4-digit room code
Real-time Enter/Leave Sync: Immediate bidirectional synchronization across all roommate devices when someone joins or leaves the flat
Zero Ghost Resurrection: Authoritative Firestore membership with kickedMembers blacklist for permanent admin removals
Clean Core Logic: Streamlined flat lifecycle without approval gates, pending queues, or modal waiting screens

Smart Flatmate Alerts: Real-time status bar notifications when meals, dishes, expenses, or deposits are logged
